regionDefinition: Existing North region: Dallas–Fort Worth and surrounding North Texas counties; this batch uses Cooke, Dallas, Denton, Ellis, Johnson and Parker.

events.title: Camp Spinistry: Bikepacking Kickoff Weekend
events.distance: About 30 or 60 mi outbound; return varies
events.description: Educational bikepacking weekend with self-navigated riding and camping. Riders arrange meals and must be self-supported.
events.notes: The listing dates the start October 17; the description includes an optional Friday gathering and Sunday return. Confirm full arrival/departure plans and registration availability.

events.title: Tour de Cure: Texas
events.distance: Metric / half metric; family distance disputed
events.venue: Community Beer Co, 3110 Commonwealth Dr, Dallas
events.description: Supported urban road fundraising ride on open streets. Fundraising minimums apply; start times vary by route.
events.notes: Official details list the family route as both 10 and 12 miles. Routes are permit-pending and subject to change. Confirm the family distance and start time with the organizer.

events.title: Old Dennis Brevets
events.venue: Pilot Travel Center / Wendy’s, 1201 I-20 West
events.description: Long-distance brevet options from Weatherford. LSR and RUSA membership and an organizer waiver are required.
events.notes: Start time is not published in the reviewed calendar. Confirm it before travel. Official cue sheets are supplied at the start; online copies are unofficial.

events.title: rideATAXIA Dallas
events.venue: Lewisville Railroad Park, 995 E Valley Ridge Blvd
events.description: Fundraising rides of 1.5, 5 and 15 miles. Check-in opens at 8:30 AM; the 15-mile ride starts at 9:30 AM and the shorter routes at 10:30 AM.
events.notes: The 15-mile route includes road and railroad crossings. Under-16 riders on that route need an adult. Routes may change.

events.title: Denton Turkey Roll Bicycle Rally
events.description: Denton Breakfast Kiwanis fundraiser with road routes and a 35-mile hybrid gravel option. Packet pickup opens at 7:00 AM; send-off is 9:00 AM.
events.notes: Route lengths may change. Choose a bicycle suitable for the selected surface; helmets are required.

events.title: La Bella Pop 114k
events.venue: Parking behind Denny’s, NW corner of SR-34 and I-35E
events.description: RUSA populaire listed by Lone Star Randonneurs, starting in Italy, Texas. Review organizer participation and waiver requirements.
events.notes: Start time is not published in the reviewed calendar. Confirm time and membership requirements with the organizer before travel.

events.title: Rudolph’s Revenge
events.description: Endurance mountain-bike race combining technical singletrack and fast fire road, with a listed 10:00 AM start.
events.notes: The page header and categories show December 12, 2026; description still says 2025. Confirm the edition and final details before booking. The URL also contains a historical year.

events.title: Texas Chainring Massacre
events.description: A self-supported North Texas gravel event with a 9:00 AM 75-mile main race, timed 50-mile race-practice option, and untimed 35-mile route; a road bike is not appropriate.
events.notes: Distances are approximate. Self-supported on public roads; no SAG. The page retains an old 2025 membership-discount deadline; confirm current discounts directly.

events.title: Head for the Hills Bicycle Rally
events.venue: Hillside Village Shopping Center, Cedar Hill
events.description: Supported road bicycle rally with rest stops and mechanical support. Organizer announces a move to May 8 for 2027.
events.notes: The home page retains a May 12 shirt deadline after the ride date; do not rely on that deadline. Confirm final routes before travel.

events.title: Burleson Honey Tour
events.venue: Centennial High School, 201 S Hurst Rd
events.description: Supported road tour starting at Centennial High School. The published schedule has an 8:00 AM departure.
events.notes: Official pages disagree between 20 and 22 miles for one route and mention a 46-mile reroute. Distances are approximate; confirm the final route choices with the organizer.
